evidence.quote: Reference benchmarks are a key part of the financial infrastructure.
The sudden cessation of a benchmark as heavily used as LIBOR would present significant systemic risks.
But I believe the ARRC has provided a workable and credible plan for creating liquidity in a new rate and beginning the process of moving trading to it.
